section.div: WhisperOS is a user-friendly operating system designed for small, portable radio devices (like Heltec LoRa boards) that allow you to communicate without the internet or cellular networks. It creates a "mesh" network where devices talk directly to each other.
The official firmware for Meshtastic, an open-source, off-grid mesh communication system.
Desktop app to generate 3D models from images or prompt using local AI — runs entirely on your GPU
27 editorial diagram types for Claude Code. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows, no Mermaid-slop.
